tagline.zh: 字号随视口在断点之间线性插值:clamp(下限, rem+vw, 上限) 生成 --step-0..5 字阶,小屏不小于下限、大屏不超过上限,中间平滑缩放。
tagline.en: Font sizes interpolate linearly with the viewport: clamp(floor, rem+vw, ceiling) builds a --step-0..5 ladder — never below the floor, never above the ceiling, smooth in between.

origin.zh: 机制 = CSS clamp()(MDN 标注 Baseline Widely available 自 2020-07,调研 05§12);主流工作流 = Utopia 流式字阶生成器,输出 --step-N: clamp(rem, rem+vw, rem)(调研 05§13 一手实测输出);比率词表出自 Tim Brown modularscale 的模数标尺(调研 05§17)。
origin.en: Mechanism = CSS clamp() (MDN Baseline Widely available since 2020-07, research 05 §12); the canonical workflow is Utopia's fluid type scale calculator emitting --step-N: clamp(rem, rem+vw, rem) (research 05 §13, first-hand measured output); the ratio vocabulary comes from Tim Brown's modularscale (research 05 §17).

effect.zh: 插值起点视口宽度:低于它,字号停在每级 clamp 的 min 值。斜率 =(max−min)/(maxVw−minVw) 以此为分母起点。默认 480px 为本条目任务规格取值;调研 05§13 的 Utopia 实测输出样本反推其默认约 360px(Utopia 未直接记录视口默认值,两说并列)。
effect.en: The viewport where interpolation starts: below it, sizes sit at each step's clamp floor; the slope = (max−min)/(maxVw−minVw) anchors here. Default 480px is this entry's task-spec value; Utopia's recorded output sample (research 05 §13) back-solves to ≈360px (Utopia does not document the viewport default directly — both stated side by side).

effect.zh: 插值终点视口宽度:高于它,字号停在每级 clamp 的 max 值。默认 1440px 为任务规格取值;Utopia 输出样本反推约 1240px(未直接记录,两说并列)。区间越宽斜率越缓,桌面端缩放越不明显。
effect.en: The viewport where interpolation ends: above it, sizes sit at each step's clamp ceiling. Default 1440px is the task-spec value; Utopia's sample back-solves to ≈1240px (not directly documented — both stated). A wider range flattens the slope, making desktop scaling subtler.

effect.zh: --step-0 的下限字号,也是字阶基准(正文下限)。默认 1rem(=16px 根字号)是常见正文基准;Utopia 实测样本用 1.125rem。以 rem 计价保证浏览器字号设置与页面缩放仍然生效。
effect.en: The floor of --step-0 and the base of the ladder (body-size floor). Default 1rem (16px root) is the common body baseline; Utopia's measured sample uses 1.125rem. Pricing in rem keeps browser font-size settings and zoom working.

effect.zh: --step-0 的上限字号(大视口下的正文尺寸)。默认 1.25rem 与 Utopia 实测输出 --step-0 的 max 值一致(调研 05§13 一手核对)。
effect.en: The ceiling of --step-0 (body size on large viewports). Default 1.25rem matches the max of --step-0 in Utopia's first-hand measured output (research 05 §13).

effect.zh: 模数比率:每升一级 step 同时乘到该级 min 与 max 上(min/ratio 同向放大)。默认 1.25 是 Utopia 可选比率之一(modularscale 记作 4:5 大三度,调研 05§13/§17)。Utopia 支持最小/最大两侧各设比率(其样本为 1.2/1.25),本条目简化为单比率双乘。
effect.en: The modular ratio: each step multiplies both that step's min and max by it. Default 1.25 is one of Utopia's selectable ratios (modularscale's 4:5 major third, research 05 §13/§17). Utopia allows separate min/max ratios (its sample used 1.2/1.25); this entry simplifies to one ratio for both.

note.zh: clamp() 为 Baseline Widely available(自 2020-07 起,MDN,调研 05§12),三大引擎当前版本均支持;调研未记录分浏览器首发版本号,此处不作逐版本断言。
note.en: clamp() is Baseline Widely available (since 2020-07, MDN, research 05 §12) and supported in all three engines today; the research did not record per-browser release numbers, so none are claimed here.

fallback.zh: 不支持 clamp() 的旧环境回退为级联两段声明:先写固定 font-size(如 1rem),再写 clamp() 声明——新浏览器以后者覆盖;或用 @supports (font-size: clamp(1rem, 1vw, 2rem)) 包裹全部流式规则,旧浏览器整组跳过,保留固定字阶。
fallback.en: On environments without clamp(), fall back through cascade: write a fixed font-size (e.g. 1rem) first, then the clamp() declaration — modern browsers override with the latter; or wrap the whole fluid rule set in @supports (font-size: clamp(1rem, 1vw, 2rem)) so old browsers skip it and keep the fixed scale.

use.zh: 全站字阶:一套 --step-0..5 变量接管正文到 display 标题,断点之间不再跳变
use.en: Site-wide scale: one --step-0..5 ladder drives body through display headlines with no breakpoint jumps

use.zh: 长文页与营销页标题随屏宽伸缩,替代成摞的媒体查询字号覆盖
use.en: Article and marketing headlines that scale with the viewport, replacing stacks of media-query font-size overrides

use.zh: hero/display 大字在移动端自动收敛到可读下限,不会撑破版心
use.en: Hero/display type collapsing to a readable floor on mobile without blowing the measure

use.zh: 设计令牌层:与 Utopia 流式间距同构,组成整套流式设计系统
use.en: As a token layer: isomorphic with Utopia fluid spacing, forming a whole fluid design system

avoid.zh: 纯 vw 字号(无 rem 下限)——用户放大系统字号无法补救,违反 WCAG 1.4.4 调整文本
avoid.en: Pure-vw sizes with no rem floor — zooming the OS font cannot rescue them (WCAG 1.4.4 Resize Text)

avoid.zh: 正文 --step-0 也大幅流式——正文两端差应控制在 1–2 级,否则小屏过大、大屏过小
avoid.en: Strongly fluid body text — keep --step-0 within 1–2 steps of range or it reads huge on phones, tiny on desktops

avoid.zh: 行高不随字阶收紧——大标题沿用正文行高会松散,正文行高低于 1.5 违反 WCAG 1.4.12
avoid.en: Line-height not tightening per step — display sizes inherit body leading; body under 1.5 violates WCAG 1.4.12

avoid.zh: 视口区间取过宽(如 320–2560)——斜率被摊平,桌面端几乎看不到缩放,白做流式
avoid.en: An overly wide viewport range (e.g. 320–2560) flattens the slope until desktop scaling is invisible

a11y.zh: 字号必须以 rem 计价并保留 rem 下限:纯 vw 字号会破坏 WCAG 2.1 SC 1.4.4(调整文本)与用户浏览器字号设置;clamp 的 min 写成 rem 即可在系统放大时跟随。WCAG 2.2 SC 1.4.12 Text Spacing 要求行高 ≥1.5× 字号、段落间距 ≥2× 字号(调研 05§18)——大字号梯级要相应收紧行高而非放大行距。
a11y.en: Sizes must be priced in rem with a rem floor: pure-vw sizes break WCAG 2.1 SC 1.4.4 (Resize Text) and user browser font settings; writing clamp's min in rem keeps OS-level zoom working. WCAG 2.2 SC 1.4.12 Text Spacing requires line-height ≥1.5× the size and paragraph spacing ≥2× (research 05 §18) — tighten leading for display steps rather than inflating it.

goal.zh: 为一篇文章页面生成 --step-0..5 流式字阶:六个 clamp() CSS 变量,字号在指定视口区间内从正文平滑放大到 display 标题,并应用到标题与正文。
goal.en: Generate a --step-0..5 fluid type scale for an article page: six clamp() CSS variables interpolating from body copy to display headline across the given viewport range, applied to headings and paragraphs.

acceptance.zh: 六个变量严格使用参数快照生成的 clamp() 字符串,不要另行发明数值
acceptance.en: The six variables use exactly the clamp() strings generated from the parameter snapshot; do not invent numbers

acceptance.zh: 中间值写为「Xrem + Yvw」双单位形式:斜率 =(max−min)/(maxVw−minVw),视口按 16px 根字号折 rem
acceptance.en: Preferred value as dual-unit 'Xrem + Yvw': slope = (max−min)/(maxVw−minVw), viewports converted to rem at a 16px root

acceptance.zh: min/max 字号均为 rem——保证浏览器缩放与用户字号设置生效
acceptance.en: min/max sizes are both in rem so browser zoom and user font settings keep working

acceptance.zh: 应用时配对收紧 line-height(标题 < 1.2,正文 ≥ 1.5,呼应 WCAG 1.4.12)
acceptance.en: Pair with tightened line-height per step: headings under 1.2, body at least 1.5 (echoing WCAG 1.4.12)

acceptance.zh: 先写固定字号声明再写 clamp 声明,旧浏览器按级联回退
acceptance.en: Declare a fixed font-size before the clamp() declaration so legacy browsers fall back through the cascade
